reviewer: Codex independent biology E.2 image counterreview
inspection: Viewed the actual original PNG and real 680x383 and 360x203 inspection copies. The warm, clear comic style fits the existing biology images; both axis labels and the large equality label are readable at 360px.

Both same-size beakers have equal fill levels and exactly three purple enzyme icons. The lower-concentration side has fewer yellow substrate icons and only one occupied active site; the higher-concentration side has more substrate icons and all three sites occupied, consistent with constant enzyme amount and reaction volume.

The graph correctly labels substrate concentration on the x-axis and enzyme activity on the y-axis, rising then approaching a plateau; the plateau aligns visually with finite available enzyme sites. This corrects the prior amount-versus-concentration mismatch and removes unrelated temperature/pH panels.

The icons represent a simplified reaction-rate saturation model. They do not measure a numeric rate or prove every enzyme has identical kinetics; supporting lesson or alt text should make that limit clear.
sourceContext: HE KCGO Biologie Ausgabe 2024 E.2 names substrate concentration as the variable for enzyme activity: https://kultus.hessen.de/sites/kultus.hessen.de/files/2024-11/kerncurriculum_gymnasiale_oberstufe-biologie.pdf
